title: Finite constant pushforward H1 lifting and naturality
statement: Let A be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], f:Y→Spec A proper, and i:Y₀→Y its cartesian closed residue fibre [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let Λ be a commutative ring, J any sheaf of Λ-modules on Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], h:V→Y finite and locally of finite presentation, M a finite Λ-module, and ψ:h_*underline M→J. For every x in H¹(Y₀,i⁻¹(h_*underline M)) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there exists z in H¹(Y,h_*underline M) such that H¹(i⁻¹ψ)(x) is the restriction of H¹(ψ)(z), using the canonical comparison between module inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and underlying abelian inverse image. Injectivity of J is not assumed.

proof.text: Finite base change and henselian H1 comparison lift x to z. Naturality of cohomology identifies the restricted image of x with the restriction of H¹(ψ)(z), using the canonical comparison between module and underlying abelian inverse images.
